name: Sinagoga del Tránsito

position.source: https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/113942748 (centroid of the outline; long axis of the prayer hall at 48.6°)

rights.note: Synagogue built 1355–1357 for Samuel ha-Leví, treasurer of Pedro I of Castile; the builder is unknown. Church of the Order of Calatrava after 1492; Museo Sefardí (Spanish Ministry of Culture) since 1964.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap way 113942748 with its building:parts 1552304773–76 — outline, the prayer hall (4 levels) and the attached strips of 3, 2 and 1 levels (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL)

notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q1811506_sinagoga_del_transito.py, tools/meshkit.py) with AI assistance. The whole OSM building is modelled, as it is one element: the prayer hall with its brick upper band, the row of small horseshoe windows under the eaves and its hipped roof of Arab tiles; the strip of the old women's gallery along the south-east front with the entrance block, the little corner loggia and the bell tower with two bells and a small pediment; the lower strip along the north-west side and the small room at the east corner. The garden to the north-west and the modern museum buildings to the north-east are separate OSM elements and are left out. Heights measured on one photo (±5 %); the north-west side and the lean-to roofs of the strips are less certain (only seen on the orthophoto). Masonry and brick courses are flat vertex colours; the plasterwork inside is not modelled.
